events.title: Code of The Savage is live in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Code of The Savage is officially part of Steam Next Fest, and the free demo is available to play now. The demo has already received several substantial updates based directly on player feedback, including improved controller support, adjustable text size, save fixes, interface improvements, and many bug fixes. events.title: Code of The Savage is coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: I’m excited to share that Code of The Savage will be taking part in Steam Next Fest this October, with a free playable demo. Explore Daneth, meet its inhabitants, and get a taste of the world I’ve spent ten years building. I’m putting the finishing touches on the demo now. It isn’t publicly available yet, but I’ll post another update when you can download it. Wishlist Code of The Savage and follow the game here on Steam for updates. Thanks for all your support! Geoff
